text:
anya: Quick sync — I want to rewrite the onramp landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Need tight hero variations, a webinar hook, and clear inbound routing for forms. Draft doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/onramp-copy-draft (WIP)

morgan: Love this. Objective: 3 headline variants per mode + single-line subhead that explains value in <10 words. My quick ideas:
- Hosted hero: 'Ship high-performance LLM features in minutes'
- Dedicated hero: 'Predictable throughput, predictable cost'
- Private hero: 'Inference under your control — audit-ready'

sam: For CTAs let's standardize: primary = try (hosted), primary sales = dedicated pricing, contact = private deployment. Forms should route: hosted -> trial signup funnel, dedicated -> pricing form (sales), private -> SE contact form. Add hidden field mode=hosted|dedicated|private for routing + utm tags.

lee: Benchmarks note: show ranges not single numbers. e.g., 95th perc latency 40–120ms depending on model/seq. We'll surface 3 model SKUs and typical token sizes. Webinar idea: 60min migration playbook + live Q&A; call it 'Serving LLMs at Scale: From POC to Production' — tie CTA into the dedicated/private flows.

copy-bot: Copied the thread into the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/onramp-copy-draft#1712348081 :white_check_mark:

anya: Quick A/B plan: hero headline A/B on hosted (week 1), subhead test on dedicated (week 2). Also want 3 tiny prompt-demo snippets for each page that render client-side (no secrets) so visitors can see a 1-2 turn example. Who can draft the snippets?

morgan: I can draft the hosted demo + 3 headline variants. Will keep them short and conversion-focused.

sam: I'll implement the form routing and add the hidden 'mode' field + UTM capture. ETA Tue. I'll also make the hosted try flow map to the free credits path.

lee: I'll pull together benchmark ranges and a short explainer copy for how we measure latency/cost. Need model list from research — can we use 'rw-small', 'rw-medium', 'rw-large' as placeholders?

anya: Yes placeholders fine for the page; we'll update before launch. Assignments recap: Morgan = hosted copy + demo snippets, Lee = benchmarks, Sam = forms + routing, Anya = webinar landing copy + promo cadence. Deadline = EOD Monday. Quick thumbs if that works.

morgan: :thumbsup:

sam: 👍

lee: :+1:

copy-bot: PR branch created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/content/onramp-copy-1712348081

anya: Great — I'll open the PR and tag reviewers @morgan @lee. I'll also draft the webinar outline and proposed send dates. Thanks team.
